title: Halifax 100 of the Maple Leaf, Ashton-Under-Lyne - WW2
memorial_details: description: This record comprises all information held by IWM’s War Memorials Register for this memorial. Where we hold a names list for the memorial, this information will be displayed on the memorial record. Please check back as we are adding more names to the database.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF/ THE GALLANT CANADIAN MEN/ WHO GAVE THEIR LIVES IN THE/ 1939 - 1945 WORLD WAR./ THESE MEN ARE/ KNOWN AS THE/ HALIFAX 100 SOLDIERS/ OF THE MAPLE LEAF./ THEY ENLISTED HERE WITH/ THE MANCHESTER REGIMENT AT/ THE LADYSMITH BARRACKS/ OF THEIR OWN FREE/ WILL TO SERVE OUR COUNTRY.
